name: Algebraic Group Theory Isomorphism
description: Transforms a graph connectivity problem into an equivalent problem in combinatorial group theory. Instead of connecting vertices to form a single component, the solver must select relations of the form g_u * g_v^{-1} = e to apply to a free group. The goal is to make the subgroup generated by the target generators a free group of rank 1. This perfectly preserves the Steiner Tree structure while completely removing all graph-theoretic vocabulary, forcing the model to bridge abstract algebra and graph connectivity.
